name: TemplrGo
description: Lightweight developer platform with Lua serverless functions, SQL playgrounds, embedded BoltDB storage, and AI chat assistant. Config-driven, single-binary deployment.
usecase: Personal website engine and developer platform — powers markdown CMS, JSON Resume rendering, docs, and release reports from one Go binary with an embedded Next.js frontend.

name: TemplrJS
description: Full-stack web framework built on NuxtJS, TailwindCSS, Supabase designed for edge computing.
usecase: Build personal projects to startups on one stack — the previous generation of the Templr family and long-running foundation of senthilsweb.com.

name: AI Agents Monorepo
description: Monorepo of Vercel Eve agents (API test generator, diagram generator, GitHub PR digest, LinkedIn cover generator) sharing a common runtime kit, plus the AI SDET Workbench slide deck.
usecase: A fleet of production AI agents with a shared runtime kit — the workbench for AI-native software engineering experiments.

name: Learn Pentaho with Senthil
description: Monorepo for learning and exploring Pentaho: ETL processes, data lake management, reporting, and visualization.
usecase: Hands-on Pentaho tutorials and examples for data engineering and analytics in real-world scenarios.

name: Dagster Data Pipelines
description: Collection of data engineering projects using Dagster to manage and orchestrate data pipelines.
usecase: Reference implementations of reliable, observable data pipelines orchestrated with Dagster.

name: TemplrPress
description: Product website, docs, blog, and OpenAPI explorer in one ~15 MB Go binary — markdown in, website out. No Node, no database, no build step.
usecase: Ship a complete product site from markdown with a single binary — zero build toolchain.

name: DuckDB Data Proxy
description: Data API and micro ORM for DuckDB and MotherDuck.
usecase: Instant REST APIs over parquet, CSV, and lakehouse data using DuckDB as the engine.

name: ClaimWise
description: Healthcare RCM synthetic data generator and data lakehouse demo monorepo — inspired by dbt's jaffle_shop.
usecase: Realistic healthcare revenue-cycle datasets for lakehouse demos, analytics practice, and teaching.

name: Agent Job Matcher
description: AI agent (Pydantic AI) + Next.js frontend that matches resumes to job postings, with OpenObserve/Arize observability — built using the AI-DLC methodology.
usecase: End-to-end example of spec-driven AI-DLC development: agent, frontend, and observability.

name: Privacy Shield Web
description: Next.js web utility implementing a Privacy Shield workflow to protect PII during text processing with LLMs: detection, anonymization, and de-anonymization.
usecase: Web frontend for the Privacy Shield PII workflow; previously also served as senthilsweb.com.

name: Zypress
description: Vue.js Jamstack framework created with NuxtJS + Tailwindcss + @nuxt/content, preloaded with personal website and documentation starter kits.
usecase: Rapidly build blog and documentation websites — an earlier generation of the Templr lineage.

name: Goduck
description: Dynamic REST API in Go inspired by RillData and MotherDuck; REST for tables and models following a micro-ORM design akin to PostgREST.
usecase: PostgREST-style instant APIs for DuckDB from a single Go binary.

name: DuckDB Studio
description: Simple, powerful web utility to explore and interact with DuckDB databases.
usecase: Browser-based SQL editor and explorer for DuckDB with SQLGlot parsing.

name: Zero-Cost Iceberg Lakehouse
description: Zero-cost Apache Iceberg lakehouse lab: Nessie catalog, Cloudflare R2, Neon PostgreSQL, and PyIceberg examples.
usecase: Build a $0 production-shaped lakehouse for learning and prototyping.

name: AI-DLC Slide Decks
description: Reveal.js slide decks built with a shared house style — currently the AI-DLC teaching deck following the live build of agent-job-matcher.
usecase: Teaching material for the AI Development Life Cycle methodology.

name: www.senthilsweb.com
description: This website: Astro static site with blog + LinkedIn feed served from a parquet file, zod-typed content, Pagefind search, satori OG cards.
usecase: Minimal, spec-driven personal website — every list on it (including this one) is a parquet file.

name: Privacy Shield
description: Secure text processing with LLMs, protecting PII using Presidio and LangChain.
usecase: Detect, anonymize, and reversibly transform PII before sending text to LLMs.

name: OpenLineage Proxy
description: Proxy utilities for OpenLineage data lineage events.
usecase: Capture and forward OpenLineage events for pipeline observability.

name: dbt-DuckDB Tickit Pipeline
description: Data engineering workflow using dbt with DuckDB for the TickitDB schema, focusing on local data lake development.
usecase: Local-first dbt development against DuckDB with a realistic schema.

name: OpenTelemetry Observability
description: OpenTelemetry logging and visualization using OpenObserve, with Otel and Fluent Bit collectors.
usecase: Drop-in o11y stack for logs today, traces and metrics tomorrow.

name: Instagram Scraper
description: Simple, serverless Instagram scraper that fetches posts as base64 images, no API key required.
usecase: Effortless content repurposing from Instagram posts.

name: Social Card
description: Dynamic image generator for business, profile, and social cards using Vercel Open Graph, Next.js, and TailwindCSS.
usecase: Generate visually appealing share cards on the edge.

name: Web2PDF
description: Webpage to PDF using Puppeteer.
usecase: Lightweight PDF export microservice for blog articles and profile cards.

name: TemplrJS LLM Chat WebUI
description: Simple LLM chat web GUI for models hosted in local Ollama and Cloudflare, using generic chat-completions API.
usecase: Edge-optimized GenAI chat with context injection for local and cloud models.

name: Notifier
description: Multipurpose notification library to send mail, text, Slack, push, Telegram notifications.
usecase: One Go library for every notification channel.

name: Zybots
description: Tiny utility functions in Python, Golang, and Node.js that act like software bots.
usecase: Grab-bag of automation bots and utility scripts.

name: MongoDB Change Streams (Go)
description: MongoDB change event streaming implemented in Go.
usecase: React to database changes in real time from Go services.

name: SQL Data Warehouse
description: Data warehousing with SQL Server: ETL processes, data modeling, and analysis.
usecase: Classic warehouse build-out reference with medallion-style layers.

name: pgOpenBeerDB
description: PostgreSQL port of the community OpenBeerDB dataset (credit: openbeerdb.com) — not my data, my packaging.
usecase: Sample relational dataset for demos and teaching.

name: Reach Helpdesk
description: Open-source helpdesk system in AngularJS + Sails.js with MongoDB RESTful services.
usecase: Full helpdesk product from the early Node.js era.

name: Strobe
description: Sails.js web application starter with Bootstrap/JQuery widgets, MongoDB, and RabbitMQ for rapid application development.
usecase: RAD starter kit from the 2014 Node.js stack.

name: Inbound Email Processor
description: Node.js script to monitor incoming emails and process them — store in MongoDB, file system, or call a webhook.
usecase: Email-driven automation before serverless made it easy.

name: Email2Twitter
description: Node.js pipeline that extracts patterns from an email inbox and posts to Twitter, persisting to MongoDB.
usecase: Early social-media automation experiment (server + web client).

name: Sakura
description: Custom, modern, enterprise-scale Microsoft .NET server application architecture — data-driven APIs with a scalable, service-oriented architecture.
usecase: Enterprise .NET application blueprint from the pre-cloud era.

name: Locations Plotter
description: Plot lat/lon coordinates in all 8 directions for a given location and distance.
usecase: Geo utility for coverage and radius calculations.
